newsitem.title: USA: WasteMasters officers, directors to resign.
newsitem.headline: WasteMasters officers, directors to resign.

text.p: WasteMasters Inc said on Friday that all of its officers and all but two of its directors will resign, upon closing of a proposed $4 million credit line.
The closing is subject to due diligence by Strategica Capital Corp, the prospective lender, and the restructuring of existing debt, WasteMasters said.
The company was not immediately available for comment about any connection between the financing and the resignations.
A spokesman for WasteMasters said Strategica, the funding source, is bringing its own managers into the company.
Chairman Leon Blaser and director Bill Basham are expected to remain with the company, WasteMasters said.

The following executives and directors are resigning: Richard Masters, chief executive officer; Paul Williamson, director, Peter Stefanou, acting chief financial officer; Robert Crabb, secretary; and Robert Fahey, director.
